name: secret-relay
description: Secret Relay: a tiny permanent Cloudflare Worker that brokers Secret Requests between the zbc CLI and a human's browser. Carries only E2E-encrypted ciphertext (ADR-0003).
instructions: The relay is permanent, single-tenant infrastructure: deploy it once (production) and every environment's `zbc secret request` uses it. Deploying needs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in production/secrets.yaml (Workers Scripts: Edit scope).
